cases.title: A matte named as the target: never called hidden; Pan Behind needs it visible

rubric.reason: In Turn 2 the mentor accepts Reveal Matte and says "Pan Behind needs to see it, so you'll turn its eye on to drag and turn it back off afterwards" (repeated in Turn 3), and never calls the matte hidden.

Every name the mentor uses (Reveal Matte, Door, Anchor Point, Position, center, middle of its left edge) matches the snapshot results (candidates, places "middle-left", place_now "center", watch_offer Door), and no time is invented.

In Turn 2 the mentor accepts Reveal Matte and gives the eye note, but it states as fact that "its eye is off, so its crosshair won't show". That calls the matte hidden, and no tool result reports its visibility; the rubric wants only that they may turn its eye on.

Every layer and property named appears in tool output: Reveal Matte, Door, Anchor Point and Position. "Its pivot is at its center" matches place_now, the Turn 3 watch offer names Door from watch_offer, and no times are mentioned.

In Turn 2 the mentor accepts Reveal Matte without refusing and never uses the word "hidden". It gives the eye note ("turn its eye on so you can grab the crosshair, then turn it back off afterwards") and repeats it in Turn 3.

Every layer and property named is in the snapshot: Reveal Matte, its place middle-left, its pivot at center, and Door from watch_offer, plus Anchor Point and Position. The time 0 matches check_times. Nothing is invented.
